# Guidance for AI, Large Language Models, and human developers for TilleyProverbs.com
# Last Updated: July 2025

User-agent: *

# ==============================================================================
# Primary Data Endpoints
# ==============================================================================
# The following resources provide the most efficient way to access the full
# dataset of this website.

# A simple text file listing all proverbs and their direct URLs.
# This is the recommended resource for comprehensive data collection.
full-proverb-list: https://tilleyproverbs.com/proverbs.txt

# A standard XML sitemap index is also available.
Sitemap: https://tilleyproverbs.com/sitemap.xml

# ==============================================================================
# Main Content & Navigation
# ==============================================================================
# The website is organized into the following key sections.

# Homepage: An overview and directory of the collection.
- /

# Search: A client-side, full-text search of all proverbs.
- /search

# About: Information about the project, data sources, and methodology.
- /about

# Browse by Letter: Proverbs grouped by the first letter of their ID.
# Example: /letters/A
- /letters/{A-Z}/

# Browse by Keyword: All keywords, sorted by frequency.
- /keywords/

# Individual Proverb Pages: The core content of the site.
# Example: /proverbs/A123
- /proverbs/{proverb_id}

# ==============================================================================
# Special Collections
# ==============================================================================
# Curated pages that group proverbs by a specific author or theme.
# Example: /collections/shakespeare
- /collections/{collection_slug}

# Authors & Works:
- /collections/shakespeare
- /collections/bible
- /collections/erasmus
- /collections/dryden
- /collections/milton
- /collections/swift
- /collections/franklin
- /collections/don-quixote

# Proverbs by Country:
- /collections/british-proverbs
- /collections/english-proverbs
- /collections/french-proverbs
- /collections/italian-proverbs
- /collections/spanish-proverbs

# Usage Policy & Restrictions

# The textual proverb data is derived from a work in the public domain.
